text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just as we begin jogging around the<n>perimeter of
the summer<n>campgrounds...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Trainer, shouldn't we be<n>takin' a break
right about now?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I've been lookin' forward to<n>some fun in
the summer sun forever<n>though!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The ocean's right there! How can Istop myself from takin' a dip?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can't take it anymore! I just gotta<n>go swimming!
choice_data_list: Why don't we do some ocean training, then?
Let's finish our training as quick as we can first!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Ocean training?! Count me in!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Should I try swimmin' into the<n>waves? Or challenge
some dolphins<n>to a race?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm down for anything! Lemme get<n>changed!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle puts her desire to play in<n>the ocean to
good use while she<n>trains.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! The quicker we finish up,<n>the quicker we
can go for a dip!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All righty! Time to buckle down for<n>some training!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Determined to get to the fun as soon<n>as possible,
Taiki Shuttle finishes her<n>training in the blink of an
eye.
